Bug_Explanation: The bug is demonstrated by performing consecutive calls to the .append method on a StringBuilder object without chaining them. Each call to append is made separately instead of reusing the target object by chaining the calls.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by asserting the result of the method showBug against an expected value that includes an extra character, ensuring the assert fails. This demonstrates the performance inefficiency due to unchained append calls in the showBug method.
